candidate_contract.canonical_nested_if_syntax: Parenthesize every nested conditional: if(first_condition, do: first_value, else: if(second_condition, do: second_value, else: fallback_value)). candidate_contract.forbidden_syntax: assignments, cond, case, guards, tuples, maps, modules, remote calls, and all function calls
candidate_contract.requirement: Return only the complete expression; use no helper bindings or functions.
